CA.rationale: C present; processing/command-estimate evidence exists but linkage to attention/allocation is not clearly an attention/allocation claim -> ambiguous binding.

COD.rationale: Content (red locations), organization/access (current/completed_record origin) and a distinct status attribution are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Processing/state labels (candidate, command_estimate, native_conditional_record) suggest content-processing conditions but do not explicitly assert an attention/allocation relation to the content presentation; linkage is unclear.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content mentions (color labels with coordinate sets) identifying content and attributes are present.

D.rationale: The report separately records identified content (red/blue coordinate sets) and a status/origin field for the same identified referent/time, meeting the differentiation criterion.

O.rationale: Explicit organization/access labels (current vs candidate, origin/inherited_current, represented_time) describe how content is presented/emerges in the system.
